'''Dhol Chants''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-2) check]].  If you pass, gain 1 [[Ally]], lose 2 [[Sanity]], and discard Dhol Chants.

'''Price''': $5

==Mythos Source==
The Dhol Chants first appeared in ''[[Wikipedia:The Horror in the Museum|The Horror in the Museum]]'' (1932), ghost-written by H.P. Lovecraft for Hazel Heald.
